Everything has to be done via online forms that have little to no relationship to reality. Sent a form - got asked to come in for a blood test. Soonest appoint for a blood test is 3 WEEKS wait - do you have any idea what can happen in 3 weeks...in what world is that acceptable service!

This practise is full of lovely people but the processes being put in place have resulted in the practise becoming almost unusable.  I feel bad for the people who work here trying to do their best.

You have to book and appointment using the NHS app - there are never any available. You have to message them (through the NHS app) - they send you a link to book an appointment  that was not available in the ap..... thats silly.

I have repeat prescriptions that i order through the NHS app (love it) - i get a text from the doctors saying i need medication review and a blood test - try to book an appointment - none available. Finally book one for three weeks time. on the day of the appointment its cancelled.

Just nothing seems to work the way its meant to. I have no idea how people who are actively unwell are coping, i worry this is situation is becoming dangerous.

I repeat - The staff are LOVELY. this is clearly a management/ownership issue.",null,[0,237]]]],[null,1704703967000000,1704703967000000,"2 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/11193878851628555994/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUXhOVTFVTmxoQkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11193878851628555994/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUXhOVTFVTmxoQkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/11193878851628555994/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUXhOVTFVTmxoQkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11193878851628555994/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUXhOVTFVTmxoQkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/11193878851628555994/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUXhOVTFVTmxoQkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/11193878851628555994/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUXhOVTFVTmxoQkVBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Terence
